LESSON: THE GIFTS OF THE HOLY SPIRIT

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 4.2: The Gifts of the Holy Spirit
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers The Gifts of the Holy Spirit, part of The Church in Grade 9 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How do you utilize the gifts of the Holy Spirit?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. discuss the teachings of Jesus Christ on the role of the Holy Spirit,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of The Gifts of the Holy Spirit in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. identify the nine gifts of the Holy Spirit,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of The Gifts of the Holy Spirit in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. classify the gifts of the Holy Spirit according to their categories,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of The Gifts of the Holy Spirit in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. utilise discerning gifts to avoid joining ungodly cults/idol worship/religious extremism,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of The Gifts of the Holy Spirit in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. read the scripture provided to get knowledge and avoid being lured to false religion or cults,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of The Gifts of the Holy Spirit in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

F. desire to be guided by the Holy Spirit in day-to-day life.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of The Gifts of the Holy Spirit in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. discuss the teachings of Jesus Christ on the role of the Holy Spirit,

   The Gifts of the Holy Spirit helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. identify the nine gifts of the Holy Spirit,

   The Gifts of the Holy Spirit helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. classify the gifts of the Holy Spirit according to their categories,

   The Gifts of the Holy Spirit helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. utilise discerning gifts to avoid joining ungodly cults/idol worship/religious extremism,

   The Gifts of the Holy Spirit helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

E. read the scripture provided to get knowledge and avoid being lured to false religion or cults,

   The Gifts of the Holy Spirit helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

F. desire to be guided by the Holy Spirit in day-to-day life.

   The Gifts of the Holy Spirit helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

G. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm on the role of the Holy Spirit in the life of a Christian,

2. read John 14:15-26, 16:5-15, Acts 1:7-8 on the role of the Holy Spirit and make notes for presentation in class,

3. jointly research on the meaning of; Gifts of the Holy Spirit, and share findings in class,

4. read 1Corithinians 12:8-11 and list the nine gifts of the Holy Spirit,

5. team up to classify the gifts according to their three categories (Gifts of Knowledge, Power and Divine Utterance),

6. brainstorm on the importance of the gifts of the Holy Spirit in Church today,

7. discuss characteristics of cults/idol worship/religious extremism/devil worship,

8. use the word of God to discern and identify cults/religious extremism/devil

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm on the role of the Holy Spirit in the life of a Christian,
2. read John 14:15-26, 16:5-15, Acts 1:7-8 on the role of the Holy Spirit and make notes for presentation in class,
3. jointly research on the meaning of; Gifts of the Holy Spirit, and share findings in class,
4. read 1Corithinians 12:8-11 and list the nine gifts of the Holy Spirit,
5. team up to classify the gifts according to their three categories (Gifts of Knowledge, Power and Divine Utterance),
6. brainstorm on the importance of the gifts of the Holy Spirit in Church today,
7. discuss characteristics of cults/idol worship/religious extremism/devil worship,
8. use the word of God to discern and identify cults/religious extremism/devil

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on The Gifts of the Holy Spirit together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and Problem-solving: the skill of research is portrayed as learners complete tasks by researching and

presenting findings in class.

● Communication and Collaboration: the skill of listening is exhibited as learners listen critically, compare perspectives,

appreciate information, and respect the opinion of others.

● Learning to Learn: the skill of organising own learning is enhanced as learners search online or use the Bible to outline the

nine gifts of the Holy Spirit (1 Corinthians 12:1-11).

Values:
● Responsibility: learners carry out different tasks/ assignments and complete them on time.

● Unity: learners work in groups and respect each other’s opinions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Extremism-detection, response; learners avoid religious extremism/cults/idol worship/devil worship by using the knowledge

from the word of God to discern false teachings/false religion and misleading doctrines. They also allow the Holy Spirit to

guide them in daily life.

● Analytical and creative thinking: learners brainstorm on the importance of the gifts of the Holy Spirit in the church today.

Link to other Subjects:

● English: learners read, discuss, and communicate effectively by sharing opinions as they make presentations.

● Pre-technical Studies: learners search online using digital devices on the meaning of the, ‘Gifts of the Holy Spirit.’

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:

1. discuss the teachings of Jesus Christ on the role of the Holy Spirit,
2. identify the nine gifts of the Holy Spirit,
3. classify the gifts of the Holy Spirit according to their categories,
4. utilise discerning gifts to avoid joining ungodly cults/idol worship/religious extremism,
5. read the scripture provided to get knowledge and avoid being lured to false religion or cults,
6. desire to be guided by the Holy Spirit in day-to-day life.

Remember the key question: How do you utilize the gifts of the Holy Spirit?
